name: The High Himalaya
title: Distributed Algorithms of the High Himalaya
people: the farmers, part-time village elders, soldiers and monks of a monastery village in the high Himalaya

hero.alt: A Himalayan village seen from above: whitewashed flat-roofed houses and prayer flags round a great white chorten, a monastery with a golden roof on its crag, barley terraces, a turquoise river in a gorge crossed by timber bridges, and a snowy mountain wall.
hero.caption: The village of Thangla. Nobody here shares a room. Every message in every scene walks one of these paths.
